_comment: The core-declared file form for chimera's project wizard: categories, cardinality (max -1 = unbounded), accepted formats, tooltip help. Chimera renders and enforces; this file decides. Slot ids are what project manifests record.

slots.title: Floppy disks
slots.help: Raw floppy disk images (.img, .ima, .xdf, .fdi, .hdm, .nfd, .d88). The first one is in drive A: at boot; the order here is the swap order used by the Previous/Next/Swap Floppy Disk inputs.

slots.title: CD-ROMs
slots.help: CD-ROM images: a plain .iso, or a .cue sheet whose referenced track files join the project automatically. The first one is in drive D: at boot; the order here is the swap order used by the Previous/Next/Swap CDROM inputs.

slots.title: Hard disk
slots.help: A raw hard disk image, mounted writable as drive C:. Writes persist for the session and can be exported as save data, and a previously exported image can be provided here to continue from it. Without one, the formattedHardDisk setting can create an empty disk instead.

slots.title: Configuration file
slots.help: Extra DOSBox-X configuration, appended after everything the sync settings compose (including [autoexec] lines). Use it for per-game tuning the settings do not cover.
